description:
Activate Splintering Wind by paying {G}, dealing 1 damage to target creature and creating a 1/1 Splinter creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Splinter, adding {G}.
When the Splinter dies, it and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Splinter trigger, dealing 1 damage to you, and putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control due to Vigor.
Repeat.
